purpose: Live Power Stack thematic radar; dynamic ranking by freshness/materiality and current market significance. Theme rank changes research priority, not company fundamental scores.

environment.label: 5% capital scarcity + selective AI funding + physical power/LNG demand
environment.summary: Capital remains expensive but discriminating rather than closed. Physical power/grid demand and institutional data-centre finance remain strong; US LNG gains a China market-access catalyst; crude scarcity premium is easing while downstream/logistics constraints persist.

whatIsNewNow: US-China talks could reduce/eliminate China's 15% tariff on US LNG ahead of Sep 24.
Nippon Life plans ~$12.75B of US infrastructure financing with substantial data-centre exposure.
Anthropic/Accenture committed at least $2B over five years to independent AI model evaluation.
Prysmian/Rio Tinto will supply low-carbon aluminium cable to an Amazon Ohio data centre.
South Korea-US investment discussions include Texas power and nuclear projects.
Oil scarcity premium eased; refined products/logistics remain the more persistent energy signal.
whatMattersMostToMarketsNow: US LNG rerouting and China market access

themes.name: Capital Scarcity / Duration + Funded-vs-Unfunded
themes.whyNow: US 10Y around 5%; financing selective rather than universally closed.
themes.marketTransmission: project finance, equity multiples, credit, housing, breadth, capex hurdle rates
themes.confirmation: 10Y near/above 5% while weaker projects require concessions and funded suppliers convert backlog
themes.invalidation: durable yield decline with improving credit/breadth and no renewed inflation
themes.nextTest: Treasury/credit trading and AI project financing

themes.name: AI Infrastructure Financing Dispersion
themes.whyNow: Nippon Life's planned ~$12.75B US infrastructure financing contrasts with stressed Oracle-linked project debt.
themes.marketTransmission: data-centre finance, supplier backlog, credit spreads, capex multiples
themes.confirmation: institutional funding continues into contracted projects while weaker structures trade at discounts
themes.invalidation: broad cancellation of funded hyperscaler projects
themes.nextTest: project debt pricing, deposits/backlog, capex guidance
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: GNRC priority research/no chase; favor funded suppliers.

themes.name: Power / Grid / Generation / Cables
themes.whyNow: Amazon generator procurement, YTL turbine reservations and Prysmian/Rio cable supply broaden physical AI bottlenecks.
themes.marketTransmission: generation, backup power, transformers, switchgear, cables, metals, utility capex
themes.confirmation: signed orders, funded projects, energised MW, FCF conversion
themes.nextTest: YTL awards/funding, supplier orders, utility capex
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: YTLPOWR hold; GNRC no-chase research; investigate Prysmian.

themes.name: US LNG Rerouting + China Market Access
themes.whyNow: US-China talks may reduce/eliminate China's 15% tariff on US LNG while replacement/diversification demand remains strong.
themes.marketTransmission: US gas demand, LNG contracting, Asian/European gas prices, trade flows
themes.confirmation: tariff cut, Chinese contracting, strong liquefaction utilization
themes.invalidation: trade talks fail and high spot LNG drives sustained demand destruction
themes.nextTest: Sep 24 US-China meeting and new SPA/cargo evidence

themes.name: Middle East Refined Products + Shipping
themes.whyNow: Diplomatic pressure and Saudi adaptation reduced immediate crude scarcity; product/logistics constraints remain more persistent.
themes.marketTransmission: diesel, freight, tanker rates, inflation, farm/consumer margins
themes.confirmation: product cracks/inventories and war-risk freight remain stressed
themes.invalidation: route normalization plus product inventory rebuild
themes.nextTest: EIA products and Saudi route normalization
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Hold existing energy; do not chase war premium.

themes.name: AI Security / Independent Model Evaluation
themes.whyNow: Anthropic/Accenture committed at least $2B over five years to independent frontier-model evaluation while AI-assisted intrusion evidence continues.
themes.marketTransmission: cyber budgets, AI governance, consulting/evaluation spend, regulation
themes.confirmation: recurring evaluation/security contracts and ARR/bookings growth
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: CRWD selective pullback; ACN differentiated research candidate.

themes.name: Uranium / Nuclear Fuel + Buildout
themes.whyNow: South Korea-US investment discussions include nuclear projects while fuel-cycle localization remains strategic.
themes.marketTransmission: uranium contracting, enrichment, reactor supply chain, long-duration power
themes.nextTest: US-Korea package details and fuel contracting
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: CCJ attractive at $91.62 but valuation requires discipline.

themes.name: Agriculture / Fertilizer / Weather Affordability
themes.whyNow: Weather and elevated fuel/fertilizer costs pressure farm margins; premium genetics and nitrogen remain less deferrable than machinery.
themes.marketTransmission: food inflation, farm margins, input volumes, machinery capex
themes.confirmation: crop/input ratios improve for high-quality inputs while weather/export disruption persists
themes.invalidation: farm margins deteriorate enough to cut core inputs
themes.nextTest: crop conditions, fertilizer pricing, export flows
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: CTVA at $80.53 back in preferred zone; AGCO second-stage only.

themes.name: Copper / Electrical Materials
themes.whyNow: FCX stabilized near preferred levels while Amazon cable procurement highlights conductor demand; tariff/inventory distortion clouds price discovery.
themes.marketTransmission: grid capex, cables, data centres, mining margins
themes.confirmation: physical premiums/orders and mine fundamentals support price after tariff reset
themes.invalidation: China demand weakens and inventories rebuild
themes.nextTest: FCX stabilization, China demand, cable orders
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: FCX $71.54 preferred-zone research; no blind buy.

themes.name: ESS Demand vs Battery Manufacturing Overcapacity
themes.whyNow: China's pause on new storage-battery manufacturing approvals reinforces strong deployment demand but poor generic cell/miner economics.
themes.marketTransmission: storage integrators, cells, lithium pricing, utility capex
themes.confirmation: deployment growth with rationalized manufacturing capacity
themes.invalidation: new capacity resumes faster than demand
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Favor storage cash conversion; generic lithium miners dormant.

themes.name: Robotics / Automation Commercialization
themes.whyNow: China/HK robotics remains active and RoboTechnik is preparing an HK listing, but valuation/commercial proof remain critical.
themes.marketTransmission: factory automation, machine vision, motion control, optical interconnect equipment
themes.confirmation: recurring external revenue and productivity ROI
themes.nextTest: RoboTechnik HK pricing and external deployments
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Fixed/warehouse first; RoboTechnik wait for pricing.

themes.name: Gold / Silver / Miners
themes.whyNow: Gold reached a one-week high and silver outperformed as easing oil moderated inflation fears despite a hawkish rate backdrop.
themes.marketTransmission: real yields, dollar, reserve diversification, geopolitical hedging
themes.confirmation: metals hold gains despite high real yields/dollar
themes.invalidation: real yields/dollar surge and ETF/physical demand weaken
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Structural hedge intact; no headline chase.
